dct_description_sm: The study aims to investigate the cumulative effects of parasites and mercury burdens on breeding eider ducks at East Bay Island. This study has two components. The first portion of the project looks at how mercury and parasite burdens affect eider duck reproduction, through experimentally manipulating parasite burdens in females arriving on the breeding colony. The second part of the project examines how mercury and lead affect the precursors that influence breeding in female eider ducks.
dct_title_s: Parasites and Contaminants in Breeding Eider Ducks, Nunavut
